content.title: 4th of July Fireworks Display
content.summary: Arvada will host its annual Fourth of July fireworks display on July 4th at Stenger Sports Complex, starting around 9:15 p.m. Food trucks will be available from 5:30 to 9 p.m., and parking will open at 6:30 p.m., with street closures beginning at 8 p.m. Attendees are reminded that personal fireworks are prohibited in the city, and any updates regarding the event will be communicated through the city's official channels.
content.body:
## Arvada's 2026 Professional Fireworks Display

The City of Arvada is planning to host its annual Fourth of July fireworks display on Saturday, July 4th at Stenger Sports Complex (1[1200 W 58th Ave](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9M2sbxmKQKqLQp4W8)).

The fireworks show will begin at approximately 9:15 p.m.

View a map of [parking lot and street closures](https://www.arvadaco.gov/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=7650).

### Stay up to date on any potential impacts to the show

**The City intends to host this year's fireworks show, but extreme weather conditions could require the event to be postponed or cancelled.**

Any potential impacts to the fireworks show will be posted on following:

- [Event webpage, arvadaco.gov/fireworks](/494)
- [City of Arvada Facebook page](https://www.facebook.com/cityofarvada)
- [City of Arvada Instagram feed](https://www.instagram.com/cityofarvada/)
- [City of Arvada newsletter, ArvadaNews](/608)

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=1337)

## Event details and timeline

- **5:30 to 9 pm**: Food trucks be onsite at Stenger Sports Complex.
- **6:30 pm**: Gates to the Stenger Sports Complex parking lots will open to vehicles. Parking is first-come, first serve. ADA parking is available in the Stenger northeast lot.
- **8:15 pm**: Vehicle access in and out of the Stenger parking lots will close.
- **9:15 pm**: Fireworks show begins (anticipated start time).
- **10:15 pm**: Streets and parking lots will re-open to vehicles.

**Please keep in mind: Once the parking lots close at 8:15 p.m., you will not be able to leave Stenger Sports Complex in your vehicle until 15 to 20 minutes after the show ends, at approximately 10:15 p.m. Vehicles will only be allowed to leave early in the event of an emergency.**

- No recreational vehicles (RVs), drones, alcohol, personal fireworks, charcoal grills, or pets allowed.
- Propane grills are allowed.

## Parking lots and street closures

- W. 58th Avenue from Kipling Parkway to Oak Street will be closed to traffic beginning at approximately 8 p.m.
- 56th Place between Oak Street and Kipling Parkway will be closed to traffic beginning at approximately 8 p.m.
- Once parking lots close, you will not be able to leave Stenger Sports Complex in your vehicle until 15 to 20 minutes after the fireworks show has ended at approximately 10:15 p.m. Vehicles will be allowed to leave early in the event of an emergency.
- Parking lots at Stenger Sports Complex will remain closed for approximately 15 to 20 minutes after the fireworks to allow for pedestrians to safely exit viewing areas.
- The [Apex Field House](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nHoUGChtaaRPNm9U9) (5724 Oak St.) and [Lutz Sports Complex](https://maps.app.goo.gl/svXt6JJeD9bfQoN89) (10664 W. 58th Ave.) will be closed off to the public during the event.
- Parking lots and streets (W. 58th Ave. and 56th Pl.) will reopen at approximately 10:15 p.m.

### Parking Lots and Street Closures Map ([click to enlarge](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=7650))

[![Map showing July 4 parking lots, road closures, and no-parking zones near Stenger Sports Complex.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7650)](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=7650)

## The use of personal fireworks in Arvada is not allowed

It's the law: The possession, manufacture, storage, sale, handling, and [use of Fireworks are prohibited (Sec 62-43)](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=PTIICOOR_CH62OF_ARTIIMIOF_S62-43FI).

In the City of Arvada, the possession and use of any fireworks (including sparklers) are illegal. Remember:

- Fireworks have the potential to start fires.
- They injure many people and cause stress to pets and other animals.
- Illegal fireworks can slow officers from responding to life-safety calls

Do not use personal fireworks in Arvada.

## How to report the illegal use of personal fireworks

To report the illegal use of personal fireworks in Arvada, please call the Fireworks Hotline at 303-980-7340. The hotline will be available between July 3 and July 5 from 7 p.m. to midnight. ONLY call 9-1-1 if it is a life-safety emergency. The Jeffcom app (available on the [App Store for iPhone and iPad](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/jeffcom-911/id1660655896)) will also have a fireworks button to report without having to call.
